messages:
maya: CI flagged red on PR #5123 — failing test matrix. I only want to re-run the failing shard(s), no image rebuild. Which commands?
infra-ben: first quick check: open the GH Actions run, expand the matrix job, note the job name and the failing step(s). If it's a matrix axis, note the axis value (e.g. python=3.10, db=postgres12).
sam: you can avoid image rebuild by using the 'light rerun' alias: `./dev/ci retry --run-id <run-id> --jobs '<job-name>' --no-image` — that will requeue the specific job(s) and preserve Docker caches.
leo: if you don't have dev tooling, use GH CLI: `gh run list --workflow ci.yaml --branch pr/5123` to get the run id, then `gh run rerun <run-id> --job <job-name>` (note: --job is supported in newer gh builds).
ci-bot: shortcut: comment `@ci-bot rerun run=<run-id> job=<job-name> keep_cache=true` — our bot will enqueue a targeted retry.
maya: run-id is 4321987654 and failing job is matrix:tests-az12-py310.
infra-ben: ok: two options — 1) targeted job rerun if it's a single flaky test, 2) shard-level requeue if several tests in the same axis are flaky. For a single failing step use the job rerun; for many, requeue the whole axis.
sam: checklist before rerun: 1) make sure PR branch up-to-date with main, 2) paste failing snippet when asking for rerun, 3) prefer `--no-image` if images are unchanged, 4) if you need to bisect, use `./dev/ci bisect --range <commit-range> --test <test-path>` and we can help.
maya: done, nudged ci-bot with comment. Thanks — will report back if it repros. :thumbsup:
